name: social-short-form-writer
description: Convert blog posts to native Instagram + TikTok captions optimized for 2026 algorithms. 2 skills: /instagram-gen (4:5 photo carousel, 5-hashtag hardcap since Dec 2025, hook-first ≤125 chars, English authoring, NO link-in-caption) and /tiktok-gen (9:16 photo-mode + video, first 150 chars critical for search index, 5-8 hashtags, link-in-caption OK). Pure content generation — emits draft JSON for an admin panel to consume. Pairs with linkedin-post-writer (long-form text + carousel routing) and ai-image-carousel-prompt-gen (universal slide image engine). Facebook Page caption authoring is handled by the consuming backend, not by this plugin (FB text reuses LinkedIn content; FB carousel reuses /instagram-gen output).
